caption: A first-person wide-angle view sits over a calm open sea under a bright low sun. Its reflection streaks across the water on the left while thin high clouds stretch overhead. The lens is heavily obscured by water droplets and splashes that blur the scene into glare. These gradually thin into scattered specks, revealing the horizon and the steady forward glide of the viewpoint across the surface. A white pointed surfboard nose enters from the lower right, settles toward the center, and holds there as the camera moves forward over rippling water, with a low strip of land appearing on the right horizon. A right hand emerging from a black sleeve then enters the right edge and paddles through the surface, kicking up small splashes before withdrawing. Once settled, the board nose remains near the center as the horizon tilts.
